description: Create the comprehensive Indonesian-language textbook (Buku Ajar) as a single large markdown document in productivity_boost/. The textbook synthesizes all 5 source books into a cohesive educational resource organized around the theme of 'Produktivitas Digital dan Komputasi Modern' (Digital Productivity and Modern Computing). The textbook must have proper pedagogical structure: kata pengantar, daftar isi, 10 bab (chapters) with learning objectives, material, examples, exercises, and summaries. Each chapter draws from one or more source books. The file should be named 'buku-ajar-produktivitas-digital.md'.
steps: Create the file productivity_boost/buku-ajar-produktivitas-digital.md with the complete textbook content in Indonesian

Structure the textbook with the following chapters (Bab): Bab 1 - Pendahuluan: Produktivitas di Era Digital (Introduction from all books); Bab 2 - Manajemen Informasi Pribadi Digital (from Book 1: PIM, curation, keeping/management/exploitation); Bab 3 - Organisasi File dan Strategi Pengambilan Informasi (from Book 1: folders vs search vs tags, user-subjective approach); Bab 4 - Dasar-Dasar Algoritma dan Pemikiran Komputasional (from Book 4: algorithm basics, complexity, sorting, searching); Bab 5 - Struktur Data dan Algoritma Lanjutan (from Book 4: data structures, graphs, dynamic programming, greedy); Bab 6 - Memahami Large Language Models (LLM) (from Book 2: what LLMs are, tokens, transformers, RLHF, chat models); Bab 7 - Rekayasa Prompt dan Pengembangan Aplikasi LLM (from Book 2: prompt engineering techniques, content, assembly, workflows, evaluation); Bab 8 - Proteksi Data Modern dan Pemulihan Bencana (from Book 5: backup/recovery basics, 3-2-1 rule, deduplication, disaster recovery); Bab 9 - Perlindungan Beban Kerja Modern (from Book 5: cloud, containers, SaaS, ransomware, DPaaS); Bab 10 - Optimasi Diri dan Pembelajaran Cepat (from Book 3: MED, self-experimentation, rapid learning, sleep, habit formation)

Each chapter (Bab) must include: Tujuan Pembelajaran (Learning Objectives, 4-6 items using Bloom's taxonomy verbs), Materi Inti (Core Material with sub-sections, detailed explanations in clear Indonesian), Contoh dan Studi Kasus (Examples/Case Studies), Rangkuman (Summary), Latihan dan Evaluasi (Exercises, 5-10 questions mixing essay and practical), Referensi (References to source book)
Write the Kata Pengantar (Preface) explaining the textbook's purpose: synthesizing 5 international reference books into accessible Indonesian learning material for students/professionals
Write comprehensive Daftar Isi (Table of Contents) at the beginning

Write Bab 1 (Pendahuluan) - introduce the 5 thematic areas, explain why each is critical for modern productivity, discuss how the 5 areas connect (managing info + algorithms for efficiency + AI/LLM tools + data protection + personal optimization)

Write Bab 2 (Manajemen Informasi Pribadi Digital) - cover PIM concepts from Bergman & Whittaker: what is PIM, why it matters, the curation lifecycle (keeping/management/exploitation), decision-making about what to keep, overkeeping problem, personal archives complexity, information types (action vs informative), accumulation patterns

Write Bab 3 (Organisasi File dan Strategi Pengambilan) - cover: hierarchical folders and their history, the search alternative (why users still prefer navigation), the tagging alternative, group information management, the user-subjective approach (subjective importance, project classification, context principles), practical implications for daily digital organization

Write Bab 4 (Dasar-Dasar Algoritma) - cover from CLRS: what is an algorithm, why study algorithms, pseudocode, analyzing algorithms, asymptotic notation (Big-O, Omega, Theta), divide-and-conquer (merge sort, quicksort), basic data structures (arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, hash tables), searching and sorting algorithms with Indonesian examples

Write Bab 5 (Struktur Data dan Algoritma Lanjutan) - cover: trees (BST, red-black, B-trees), graph algorithms (BFS, DFS, shortest paths, MST), dynamic programming (principles, examples like rod cutting and LCS), greedy algorithms, NP-completeness (basic concepts), brief intro to machine learning algorithms from CLRS 4th ed

Write Bab 6 (Memahami Large Language Models) - cover from Berryman & Ziegler: what LLMs are (text in/text out, document completion), training process, tokens and tokenization, how LLMs see text differently from humans, auto-regressive generation, temperature and probabilities, transformer architecture (attention), RLHF and alignment, base models vs chat models, the Chat Completion API

Write Bab 7 (Rekayasa Prompt dan Aplikasi LLM) - cover: prompt engineering as a discipline, prompt content (static vs dynamic), assembling the prompt (anatomy of ideal prompt, document types), few-shot prompting, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), taming completions, tool usage and conversational agency, LLM workflows (basic and advanced), evaluation (offline and online), multimodality and future directions

Write Bab 8 (Proteksi Data Modern) - cover from Preston: why we back up (risks: human, mechanical, natural disasters, ransomware), RPO and RTO, backup vs archive, the 3-2-1 rule, backup levels (full/incremental), deduplication (source vs target), using disk in backup systems, recovery concepts (image/file/instant), traditional and modern backup methods

Write Bab 9 (Perlindungan Beban Kerja Modern) - cover: protecting physical/virtual servers, desktops/laptops/mobile, databases, cloud (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS), containers and Kubernetes, disaster recovery planning (hot/warm/cold sites), DPaaS, replacing/upgrading backup systems, choosing solutions, ransomware-specific protections (immutability, air gaps)

Write Bab 10 (Optimasi Diri dan Pembelajaran Cepat) - cover from Ferriss: the Minimum Effective Dose concept, rules that change the rules (questioning conventional wisdom), the Harajuku Moment (decision points), self-experimentation methodology, data-driven personal improvement, sleep optimization, rapid skill acquisition principles, the value of self-experimentation, spotting bad science

Write closing section: Penutup (Closing) summarizing the 5 pillars of digital productivity, Daftar Pustaka (Bibliography) listing all 5 source books with full citations, Glosarium (Glossary) of key terms in Indonesian with English equivalents

Ensure total content is comprehensive (target 3000-4000+ lines of markdown), with clear formatting using headers (##, ###), tables, bullet points, numbered lists, blockquotes for key insights, and code blocks for algorithm pseudocode
acceptance_criteria: File productivity_boost/buku-ajar-produktivitas-digital.md exists and is well-formed markdown
Content is written entirely in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) with technical terms in English where appropriate
All 10 chapters (Bab) are present with complete content
Each chapter has Tujuan Pembelajaran, Materi Inti, Contoh/Studi Kasus, Rangkuman, and Latihan/Evaluasi
All 5 source books are well-represented across the chapters
The textbook has a clear Kata Pengantar, Daftar Isi, and closing sections (Penutup, Daftar Pustaka, Glosarium)
Total document length is at least 3000 lines
Algorithm pseudocode examples are included in Bab 4 and 5
Prompt engineering examples are included in Bab 6 and 7
Practical exercises are included in each chapter
verification: Run: head -100 /projects/sandbox/sonet-product/productivity_boost/buku-ajar-produktivitas-digital.md (verify Indonesian content and structure)
Run: grep -c 'Tujuan Pembelajaran' /projects/sandbox/sonet-product/productivity_boost/buku-ajar-produktivitas-digital.md (should be 10, one per chapter)
Run: grep -c 'Latihan' /projects/sandbox/sonet-product/productivity_boost/buku-ajar-produktivitas-digital.md (should be 10+, exercises in each chapter)
